custom_sessions.description: Long-running test session — updates status every 2s via file and IPC
custom_sessions.name: Status Ticker

custom_sessions.command: CURRENT=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' Cargo.toml | head -1) && echo "Current version: $CURRENT" && read -p "Release version (major|minor|patch|<ver>): " version && bash scripts/release.sh "$version"
custom_sessions.description: Run release script to bump version and tag
custom_sessions.name: Release

prompt_templates.body: update the changelog, start a pr, merge the pr
prompt_templates.name: push

prompt_templates.body: Perform a {{ semver type:patch|minor|major }} version release using the release skill
prompt_templates.name: Release

prompt_templates.body: Look at the {{ plan_name }} plan and start implementing the next actionable item. Make sure the code and plan doc are updated from main before starting
prompt_templates.name: next plan item

prompt_templates.body: update the changelog and backlog doc (if applicable), start a pr, give me back the PR numbber. If we generated a screenshot artifact include that in the PR description. Give me back a link to the PR. Make sure the link is formatted correctly (often there is a trailing ")")
prompt_templates.name: Start PR

prompt_templates.body: if we haven't already for this feature, use the "/amf-screenshot" skill to show me what was changed for this feature
prompt_templates.name: screenshots

prompt_templates.body:
check the {{ doc name }} backlog doc and a new unchecked item if it doesnt exist already:

{{ doc item }}
prompt_templates.name: update backlog doc
